technique_name: Explain how AI can benefit the healthcare industry.
description: AI has the potential to revolutionize the healthcare industry by helping to reduce costs, streamline processes, improve accuracy of diagnosis and better predict outcomes. AI-powered applications can automate and optimize mundane tasks in healthcare, such as data entry and records management. AI-powered diagnosis and drug discovery technologies can provide more accurate, efficient and personalized diagnoses and treatment plans.
